actual_tool_arguments.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. This is a conservative FAITHFUL higher-resolution repaint of the exact old bitmap, not a redesign. Match the entire original image with deliberate source softness, low contrast and ALL original fine stroke phase. Do not add detail where the source is blurry.

CRITICAL: The upper-left lash zone is a flat schematic of MANY extremely FINE existing one-native-pixel hairline strokes with narrow spaces and asymmetric tips, not a few thick triangular spikes. Copy the original fine stroke pattern/count/density/phase exactly, maintaining native hairline widths (about four output pixels for a one-native-pixel stroke) and source terminal fades. No coalescing strokes, thickening them, new strokes, uniform comb or simplified row of heavy teeth/spikes. Keep the original lash support pigment and its exact UV bounds. Preserve the thin dental schematic below it unchanged; do not regularize tooth count or brighten white bands. Retain every other atlas region, original source face/eye expression or uniform gray test quadrant exactly.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit ONLY this exact ENTIRE original Silent Storm facegen test UV color atlas into four-times finer paint resolution. Image1 is the complete actual native stored RGB edit target. Preserve ALL normalized UV coordinates, complete square size, source pigment and material, exact native shape/count/phase and ALL black unused fields. The lower-left 128x128 field is UNIFORMLY LIGHT GRAY, with NO face, hair or portrait. Keep it absolutely uniform gray, no invented anatomy or shading. Upper-left quarter contains the existing tiny lash strokes against WHITE support at the top edge, narrow low-contrast schematic dental strip below it, and flat maroon support beneath. Preserve every existing lash stroke and dental separation exactly; do not add eyelashes, brighter teeth or dental rows. Adjacent eye field contains one small blue-gray painted iris, one pupil and the source dim highlights on gray wash. Keep the original eye shape, positions, reflections and low contrast, no veins, new catchlights, sharp limbal ring or realistic sclera. All regions remain exactly where they are. No rotation, Vflip, cropping, rearranging, fitting, margins, registration or physical pattern scale changes. Improve only original soft painted edges; no grain, pores, fibers, metallic sheen, relief or new objects. Whole original alpha and brightness are restored programmatically; produce the entire opaque stored RGB canvas.
